title: FantacalcioVoteRecord
description: One row normalized from the authoritative Redazione Italia (`Italia`) sheet of the private Fantacalcio XLSX. ALL (allenatore) rows are kept raw but excluded from the player model.

external_id.description: From the 'Cod.' column. external_id for source_id=fantacalcio_xlsx; NOT assumed stable cross-season.

canonical_player_id.description: Assigned only by validated identity/promotion. Null until then.

team.description: Forward-filled from the team-label block row by the parser.

voto_raw.description: Cell value verbatim: number or token such as '6*', 'SV' or ''.

voto_base.description: Numeric base vote; e.g. '6*' -> 6; SV/blank -> null.

is_real_performance.description: False for asterisk/SV/blank; true for a genuine numeric Redazione Italia grade.
